units.source_text: 父亲头也没回，突然骂了我一句。

en.t: Without even turning his head, Father suddenly scolded me.

units.source_text: 不仅这样，就连旁边的哥哥也不怀好意的瞪了我一眼。

en.t: Not only that, even my elder brother beside him gave me a malicious glare.

units.source_text: 我垂头丧气的悄悄回到屋里。

en.t: Dejected, I quietly went back into the room.

units.source_text: 不知何时，母亲已经睁开眼醒了过来，看着自己搭在脸上的手掌。

en.t: At some point, Mother had opened her eyes and awakened, and was looking at the hand she had laid across her face.

units.source_text: 看到我走进屋里，竟然无比清醒的 问：“你爸爸是不是骂你了？”

en.t: When she saw me come into the room, she asked with surprising clarity, "Did your father scold you?"
